decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The retention of the existing single-storey rear extension with proposed alterations, due to its excessive height and bulk, would result in an unacceptable loss of residential amenity to the neighbouring properties by reason of loss of light and enclosure, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and ENV.1.2 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4. and ENV-B.2.2. and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).

Condition : 2 - 2/ The single-storey rear extension, by reason of its size, position and appearance, would detract from the character of the original dwellinghouse and would represent an unduly obtrusive feature within the streetscene, failing to maintain or enhance the character of Heston Village Conservation Area, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and ENV.1.2 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4. and ENV-B.2.2.
description: RETENTION AND ALTERATIONS TO A SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE
